cleaners.description: List of BleachBit cleaners to execute (e.g., 'firefox', 'tmp', 'cache') — must match documented cleaner names from `bleachbit -l` output

preview.description: Preview files to be deleted instead of actually deleting them

overwrite.description: Overwrite files before deleting them to hide contents

shred_paths.description: List of specific files or directories to securely shred

wipe_free_space_paths.description: List of paths (filesystems) where free space should be wiped

debug_log.description: Path to file where debug messages should be logged

use_preset.description: Use options set in the graphical interface (e.g., saved preset)

launch_gui.description: Launch the graphical interface instead of CLI mode
